nodes.description: Private owner address of FerpaidFinance; set to deployer and used in access control requires.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated in transferFrom, approveAndCall and constructor.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, read/decremented in transferFrom and written in approve.
Private mapping controlling which addresses bypass the sale conditions; set true in approveAndCall.
Private mapping counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private sale count limit read in condition.
Private minimum sale value read in condition.
Private maximum sale value read in condition.
Address allowed to bypass sale conditions; written by owner in transferownership.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant decimals value (18) used in supply and balance scaling.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom that checks allowance, calls ensure, and mutates balances and _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function that mints/assigns balance to spender and marks canSale[spender].
Owner-only function that sets tradeAddress.
Internal view gate checking owner/tradeAddress/canSale bypass and delegating to condition.
Internal view sale-condition checker over _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balance.
msg.sender used as the source in transfer and as the spender in transferFrom.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender checked against owner in approveAndCall.
msg.sender checked against owner in transferownership.
msg.sender used as the deployer identity that becomes owner and initial balance holder.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (guarded by require balanceOf[_from] >= _value).
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom (arithmetic overflow risk).
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom (guarded by require).
Unchecked multiplication balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) in approveAndCall (arithmetic overflow).
Unchecked multiplication totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) in the constructor (arithmetic overflow).
Low-level external call address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn, a reentrancy vector.

edges.reason: transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument into transferFrom.

approveAndCall requires msg.sender == owner before minting balance and enabling canSale.

transferownership requires msg.sender == owner to change tradeAddress.
Caller identity controls assignment of the privileged tradeAddress variable.
Deployer msg.sender becomes owner in the constructor.
